name: Assistance for Cultivation of Medicinal/ Aromatic Crops
benefit: - Financial assistance up to 75% of the cost or ₹11,250/- per hectare, whichever is lower.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant must be a farmer.
   1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
   1. Applicant must possess cultivable land ranging from 0.20 hectares to 4 hectares.
